description: Crosswalk mapping external biomedical annotated corpora onto the project entity/relation label scheme. Add a new corpus block + reader to onboard each corpus; the project labels stay stable. Research-use only.

bc5cdr.source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tner/bc5cdr (token-level NER mirror of BioCreative V CDR)
bc5cdr.license: BioCreative V CDR corpus; US NLM, free for research use. PubMed-derived text.
bc5cdr.notes: This mirror is token-level NER only: original PubMed PMIDs, character offsets against source, and chemical-induced-disease relations are NOT included. Use BioRED BioC for relations + PMIDs + GENE/CELL_TYPE.

biored.license: BioRED (Luo et al., Brief Bioinform 2022); NCBI / NLM research corpus. PubMed-derived abstracts. Research-use only.
biored.notes: BioC JSON documents use PubMed PMIDs as ids, absolute character offsets, six entity types, and document-level relations keyed by entity identifiers. OrganismTaxon is intentionally unmapped (no project label). SequenceVariant maps to BIOMARKER.

ebm_nlp.license: EBM-NLP corpus (Nye et al., ACL 2018); PubMed abstracts with PICO span annotations. Research-use only.
ebm_nlp.notes: Uses aggregated starting_spans for interventions and outcomes (participants omitted: no project label). Token labels are collapsed to character spans on a single-space token join. Prefer test/gold over test/crowd. Hierarchical Intervention subtypes are not consumed in this reader.

treatment_stub.source: Local research stub JSONL (Intervention/Procedure spans). Prefer --corpus ebm_nlp for the peer-used TREATMENT path.
treatment_stub.license: Research fixture only; not a peer-reviewed corpus release.
treatment_stub.notes: Smoke-path only. Onboards TREATMENT via Intervention/Procedure source labels. Observe-only; does not claim clinical annotation quality.

future_project_labels.TREATMENT: from ebm_nlp (Intervention starting spans) via gbmbert-import-external-corpus --corpus ebm_nlp; treatment_stub remains a smoke fixture
future_project_labels.OUTCOME: from ebm_nlp (Outcome starting spans) via --corpus ebm_nlp
future_project_labels.BIOMARKER: from biored (SequenceVariant) via --corpus biored; richer biomarker-specific corpora can refine later
